title: Structure of Plot Systems and Economic Activity in Cities: Linking Plot Types to Retail and Food Services in London, Amsterdam and Stockholm
tradition: 地塊形態與城市經濟活動
method: Crossref abstract review; comparative plot-system analysis using size, compactness and frontage index

claims.claim_zh: 摘要以倫敦、阿姆斯特丹和斯德哥爾摩比較地塊大小、緊湊度與 frontage index 等形態指標，並分析其與零售及餐飲活動分布的關聯。
claims.scope_zh: 摘要支持地塊系統、尺度和臨街條件的比較範圍；不據此推斷阿姆斯特丹運河屋的單一面寬值。

query.title: Structure of Plot Systems and Economic Activity in Cities: Linking Plot Types to Retail and Food Services in London, Amsterdam and Stockholm

verification.match_notes_zh: Crossref 記錄核對題名、作者、年份和期刊；公開摘要列出地塊大小、緊湊度、臨街指數及阿姆斯特丹案例。

limitations_zh: 只核對 Crossref 書目與摘要，未查閱全文；不確認特定歷史地塊尺寸。
